plugins.description: Scott's end-to-end workflow for Claude Code: chart an effort as a wayfinder map, resolve it, review the map, distill and review the spec, break it into tickets, and ship it wave by wave — driven by /next, every review gate on the finding-pipeline contract — plus standalone skills for grilling, design, domain modeling, prototyping, research, TDD, wizards, and writing for agents.
